meta.title: DeepSeek Whale Widget
meta.description: A resident whale at the bottom-right corner: DeepSeek balance and bonus, official today's spend, per-turn cost narration, peak countdown, low-balance and daily-budget alerts, a usage log, a right-click menu (refresh / balance detail / today's weather / settings), a nickname greeting when DSH opens, and six hand-drawn expressions. All data stays on this machine.
